card.name: Deep-time spans: millions and billions of years
card.fires_on: Words that start a huge time span in geology, astronomy or evolution, such as 'eons', 'millions' or 'billions' before 'of years', or a number of years ago.

modes.label: Eons and millions
modes.description: The word eons or millions right after 'for' or 'over', describing very long durations.
modes.example: Since this distant light took e<<ons>> to reach Earth, the map is essentially

modes.label: Billions after a number or in 'ago' phrases
modes.description: Billion or years in dating of planets, rocks or stars, followed by 'years ago'.
modes.example: The rocks at the bottom of the canyon date back to 4<< billion>> years ago.

card.writes: It pushes words about geology and evolution, such as geological and evolutionary, and the Chinese terms for evolution and geology.
card.plain: It notices when text is talking about immense spans of time, like millions or billions of years in Earth or space history.
